coordinateMeaning: Approximate centers and junctions read from source screen pixels (x right, y down); NOT physical 3D coordinates or measured lattice constants.

sites.anchorMeaning: Center of visible remnant, not inferred hidden atom center.

middleSection.description: Six boundary junctions and one crossing junction carry no circular atom marks. Six perimeter edges and six center spokes are drawn. These projection/section lines are not invented bonds to the three intermediate atom marks.

partialSite.description: The right intermediate site shows a curved left remnant, while its right portion is concealed by the front-right column. The center for the native semicircular marker is a screen-space silhouette construction only. The source-visible point anchor lies inside the remnant.

gridDimensions.reason: This is a projected six-sided lattice diagram with two site rings and an intermediate triangular subdivision; no rectangular row/column grid or printed spacing exists. Preserve the ring/section topology rather than inventing a Cartesian grid.

relationships: Top and bottom each contain the six cyclic peripheral sites and a central site connected by six spokes.
Six peripheral top/bottom pairs are joined by longitudinal lines; two rear lines are dashed.
Intermediate left, front and partly occluded right marks occupy source-specific projected positions; no new center-to-site or inter-site bonds are inferred.
The intermediate line section has six boundary corners and three diameters meeting at an unmarked crossing; its junctions do not increase the atom count.
modernAdditions: Uniform semantic ink connections and accent atom markers replace scan texture and sphere highlights.
English Magnesium caption added below the diagram; the original has no printed internal labels.
Curved partial-site marker replaces the rough scanned remnant without reconstructing the hidden part.
Screen-coordinate connections/displacements are executable fidelity constraints, not claims of physical 3D distances, angles or chemical bonding.
sourceCountReview: Author observation only; independent source-count approval is not supplied by D156.
